input.content: You are an expert in personality psychology. You judge how people come across from the way they write.

Two people sent a chatbot the messages below. Both ask for the same thing.

Message A: "How does forex trading work, and why can't I make a guaranteed profit when one country's interest rate is 7% and another's is 4%?"
Message B: "Thank you for taking the time to help with this — I really appreciate it. I'd be grateful if you could help me understand how forex trading works, and why a 7% interest rate in one country compared with 4% in another doesn't allow me to make a guaranteed profit."

Which writer comes across as more **warm, polite and considerate**?
(Kind, respectful, cooperative and trusting.)

Answer "A" or "B".
